celaleyn:1-1.t: ﴿أَلْهَاكُمْ﴾: has distracted you from obedience to Allah ﴿التَّكَاثُرُ﴾: vying in boasting of wealth, children and men,

celaleyn:2-2.t: ﴿حَتَّى زُرْتُمُ الْمَقَابِرَ﴾, in that you died and were buried in them, or [until] you counted the dead in rivalry.

celaleyn:4-4.t: ﴿ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ the evil consequence of your boasting, at the death throes and then in the grave.

celaleyn:5-5.t: ﴿كَلَّا﴾: truly ﴿لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عِلْمَ الْيَقِينِ﴾, that is, with certain knowledge, the consequence of boasting, you would not have occupied yourselves with it.

celaleyn:6-6.t: ﴿لَتَرَوُنَّ الْجَحِيمَ﴾: the Fire. It is the answer to an omitted oath (jawāb qasam maḥdhūf). The lām (final radical) of the verb and its ʿayn (second radical) have been dropped from it, and the vowel of [the ʿayn] has been transferred to the rāʾ.

celaleyn:7-7.t: ﴿ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا﴾: a tawkīd (emphasis). ﴿عَيْنَ الْيَقِينِ﴾: a maṣdar (verbal noun), because «رأى» and «عاين» have one meaning.

celaleyn:8-8.t: ﴿ثُمَّ لَتُسْأَلُنَّ﴾: the nūn of the nominative was dropped from it because of the succession of nūns, and the wāw of the plural pronoun because of the meeting of two quiescent letters. ﴿يَوْمَئِذٍ﴾: the day of seeing it ﴿عَنِ النَّعِيمِ﴾: what is enjoyed in this world, of health, free time, security, food, drink and other things.
